title: Emission factor / 排放系數
description: One emission factor record. One YAML file under data/factors/ holds exactly one record.

id.description: Stable unique id: dot-separated lowercase segments, e.g. hk.energy.fuel.diesel.ipcc2006

gas.description: Which gas the value covers. CO2e means all gases converted with the GWP set in gwp.

gwp.description: GWP set used when gas is CO2e

unit.description: Emission per activity unit. Allowed units are listed in schema/units.yaml.

year.description: Reference year the factor describes (not the publication year)

region.description: HK = all Hong Kong; HK-CLP / HK-HKE = CLP or HK Electric supply area; GLOBAL = international default

scope.description: GHG Protocol scope this factor is normally used for

derivation.description: Required when the value is not copied as-is from the source: show the arithmetic.

quality.description: A HK government; B HK utility/company/institution; C international default or peer-reviewed; D estimate. See methodology/data-quality.md

status.description: draft = entered, not yet cross-checked; reviewed = checked by a second person; deprecated = superseded

verification.description: Independent checks of the value against the source. Each entry records who read the value, how, and what they got. Every value must equal `value`; `status: reviewed` needs two entries that differ in `by` or `method`, at least one by the maintainer. See methodology/verification.md.

by.description: maintainer = the human project lead; claude = AI assistant; contributor:<github-handle> = anyone else

method.description: pdf-visual = read on the rendered page; text-extract = read from extracted text; recalculation = recomputed from other published numbers
